Its Board of Directors is composed primarily of directors of the member corps.  The stated purpose of a DCI corps is "...to provide a life changing experience for youth through the art of marching music performance."  The DCI competitive summer tour, consisting of DCI-sanctioned competitions throughout the United States, culminates in August with the week-long DCI World Championships.
